rows.name: Applications.Sorting.sorters_eq_at
rows.intended_statement: For an arbitrary Type u, relation r with Std.Antisymm r, functions f and g, and one input xs, Pairwise r plus occurrence permutation for each output implies f xs = g xs.
quantifier_and_hypothesis_checks: Arbitrary universe and payload type; no equality decision or inhabitant
Std.Antisymm r is the only relation class
Correctness is local to the given input, not universally quantified over all inputs
rows.proof_connection: Reuses List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' after composing hf.2 : f xs ~ xs with hg.2.symm : xs ~ g xs.
rows.domain_and_nonweakening_assessment: No new sorting carrier or list uniqueness proof. Pairwise plus Perm preserves multiplicities. The relation need not be total, reflexive, or transitive.
rows.elaborated_type_exact:
@Applications.Sorting.sorters_eq_at.{u_1} : ∀ {α : Type u_1} (r : α → α → Prop) [@Std.Antisymm.{u_1 + 1} α r]
  (f g : List.{u_1} α → List.{u_1} α) (xs : List.{u_1} α),
  And (@List.Pairwise.{u_1} α r (f xs)) (@List.Perm.{u_1} α (f xs) xs) →
    And (@List.Pairwise.{u_1} α r (g xs)) (@List.Perm.{u_1} α (g xs) xs) → @Eq.{u_1 + 1} (List.{u_1} α) (f xs) (g xs)
rows.assessment: matches intended statement; no concrete finding
